REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL — Managed IT service desk and end-user support
Riverton Regional Health Network (fictional) · RRHN-IT-2026-04

1. Introduction
Riverton Regional Health Network (fictional) invites proposals for: managed it service desk and end-user support.
Scope: 24/7 service desk, on-site end-user support at 6 clinics, device lifecycle management for about 2,400 devices and monthly service reporting, for a 3-year term with an optional 2-year extension.

2. Timetable
Clarification questions close: 2026-11-16 at 17:00
Supplier Q&A session (online): 2026-11-19 at 15:00
Proposal submission deadline: 2026-11-30 at 12:00
Shortlisted bidder demonstrations: 2026-12-09
Proposal validity: 90 days after the submission deadline
All times are local time at the buyer's offices. Late proposals will not be considered.

3. Evaluation criteria
Proposals will be scored against the criteria and weightings below. Quality questions are scored from 0 to 5 and then weighted.
Q1 — Service desk model and service levels — 30% — How the desk is staffed, how tickets flow and how service levels are met and reported.
Q2 — Security and data protection — 20% — Access control, patient data protection, incident response and certifications.
Q3 — On-site support and device lifecycle — 15% — Clinic support model, device imaging, repair and secure disposal.
Q4 — Transition and continuous improvement — 10% — Knowledge transfer from the incumbent and how the service improves over time.
P1 — Price — 25% — Total evaluated price from the price schedule.

4. Documents to be returned
Bidders shall return the following documents. A proposal missing any mandatory document may be rejected as non-compliant.
- Signed form of tender (Mandatory)
- Technical proposal answering Q1 to Q4 (max 30 pages) (Mandatory)
- Completed price schedule (Mandatory)
- Information security certificate or audit report (Mandatory)
- Completed security questionnaire (Annex C) (Mandatory)
- Draft service level agreement (Mandatory)
- Three client references (Mandatory)
- Sample monthly service report (Optional)

5. Instructions to bidders
Proposals shall be submitted in English through the buyer's e-procurement portal. Email submissions will not be accepted.
Questions shall be raised through the portal before the clarification deadline. Answers will be shared with all bidders without naming the bidder who asked.
Bidders shall not contact evaluators directly during the procurement. Canvassing will lead to exclusion.
The buyer is not bound to accept the lowest priced or any proposal and will not reimburse bid costs.

docs.label: Terms and conditions
pages:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT
Riverton Regional Health Network (fictional) · RRHN-IT-2026-04

1. Definitions and interpretation
In these conditions, the Buyer means the contracting authority named above and the Contractor means the successful bidder.

2. Contractor obligations
2.1 Data protection. The supplier shall process patient and staff data only on the Network's documented instructions and keep it in the agreed data region.
2.2 Certification. The supplier should hold a current information security certification or provide a recent independent audit report.

3. Commercial terms
3.1 Insurance. The supplier shall hold professional indemnity and cyber liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000 each.
3.2 Payment. Charges are invoiced monthly and paid within 30 days; service credits apply when service levels are missed.

4. Termination
Either party may terminate for material breach that is not remedied within 30 days of written notice.
5. Governing law
The contract is governed by the law of the Buyer's jurisdiction.

docs.label: Technical specification
pages:
TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION
Riverton Regional Health Network (fictional) · RRHN-IT-2026-04

1. Purpose
This specification sets out the minimum requirements for: managed it service desk and end-user support. 'Shall' means a mandatory requirement; 'should' means a desirable requirement that will be considered in scoring.

2. Requirements (part 1)
2.1 Service desk. The service desk shall operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, by phone, email and self-service portal.
2.2 Service levels. Priority 1 incidents shall be responded to within 15 minutes and resolved or worked around within 4 hours, 24/7.
2.3 Service levels. At least 70% of service desk tickets should be resolved at first contact, measured monthly.

3. Requirements (part 2)
3.1 On-site. On-site engineers shall attend clinic incidents within 4 business hours when remote fixes fail.
3.2 Devices. The supplier shall image, deploy and securely wipe devices, and provide a data destruction certificate for every disposed device.
3.3 Security. All supplier staff shall use multi-factor authentication and named accounts; shared administrator accounts are not permitted.

4. Requirements (part 3)
4.1 Security. Security incidents affecting the Network's data shall be notified to the Network within 24 hours of discovery.
4.2 Reporting. The supplier shall provide a monthly service report covering ticket volumes, service levels, trends and improvement actions.
4.3 Languages. The service desk shall provide support in English and Spanish during all opening hours.

kb.title: Past proposal — Meadowbrook Care Group
kb.text: Our service desk runs 24/7 from two hubs, by phone, email, chat and a self-service portal. Calls are answered by engineers, not dispatchers, so most issues are fixed on the first call.

kb.title: Service level history
kb.text: Across healthcare clients in FY2025, Priority 1 incidents had a median response time of 9 minutes, and 74% of tickets were resolved at first contact.

kb.title: On-site support model
kb.text: Field engineers are based within 45 minutes of each clinic. When a remote fix fails, an engineer is on site within 3 business hours.

kb.title: Device lifecycle procedure
kb.text: Devices are imaged with the client's standard build, asset-tagged and deployed. At end of life they are wiped to a recognised standard, and a destruction certificate is issued per serial number.

kb.title: Access control policy
kb.text: All engineers use named accounts with phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication. Privileged access is time-limited and logged; shared administrator accounts are prohibited.

kb.title: Security incident response
kb.text: Security incidents are triaged within 1 hour. Clients are notified within 12 hours of a confirmed incident affecting their data, with a written report within 5 days.

kb.title: Monthly service report sample
kb.text: The monthly report covers ticket volumes, service level performance, top recurring issues, satisfaction scores and an improvement plan with owners and dates.

kb.title: Information security certificate
kb.text: Independent information security management certification, valid until 2028, covering service desk, field services and device lifecycle.

kb.title: Insurance summary
kb.text: Professional indemnity USD 10,000,000; cyber liability USD 5,000,000.

kb.title: Transition playbook
kb.text: A 60-day transition with knowledge capture workshops, shadow running alongside the incumbent and a go-live readiness review with the client.
